==============================================================================
UI commands --------------------+     useAgentCanvasBridge

                                v                     v
MappingDocumentController.applyUpdate(expectedVersion, operations)
  transact(...) = same path; check version + 1..100 operations
  clone snapshot -> stage operations in order
       |
       +-- create / insert / replace / patch / mappings / jumps
       |     DiagramService.create / getRevision / revise [G]
       |     track old->new node IDs across staged edits
       +-- diagram-revision-apply: check expectedRevisionId
       +-- edge create/update/remove: schema + anchor validation
       +-- grid move/group/collapse/remove: cells + layoutScene
       +-- floating move/collapse/remove: pixels + display tree
       +-- subtree collapse: revision-scoped diagramViews
       |
       v
updateSnapshot: reconcile edges/jumps, normalize views,
  clean selection/focus, resolve floating layout, validate connections
       |
       +--> history.append(document, canvas, node correspondence) [E]
       +--> canonical issued diagrams -> snapshot version++ -> listeners
Selection commands -> updateSelection -> recorded canvas update
Transient updateCanvas(record=false) -> no history/version advance
nodes() -> cached derived registry -> cloned result
apply-diagram-revision -> receiver -> persistence.sync -> storage.flush
